text: Meet the AI Copilot: a chat assistant that creates and edits your commands, always asking for your approval before changing anything, with a credit wallet (1 credit = 1,000 tokens) you can top up by watching rewarded ads. BDFD commands now run on a new native engine and can be tried in a built-in command sandbox before you publish, and visual blocks now run natively too, with many new blocks for moderation, roles, threads, voice, polls, AutoMod, webhooks and images. The command editor is simpler: each option is edited on its own screen with a live Discord preview, and version history now uses cloud checkpoints with previews and deletion. The app has a flatter, calmer redesign with a top navigation bar on desktop and a live hosting countdown on your home cards. Bot Creator Studio, a web version of the editor, is now available. Fixed: importing a bot now updates its status and activities, startup no longer disturbs running bots, commands keep their identity when saved or restored, deleted items stay deleted, and several layout overflows on small phones.
